SELECT cs.session_id AS sessionId, cs.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, st.center_code AS centerCode, cs.status AS sessionStatus, cs.session_date AS sessionDate, r.time_slot AS timeSlot, cs.entered_at AS enteredAt, cs.exited_at AS exitedAt, cs.quiz_started_at AS quizStartedAt, cs.result_viewed_at AS resultViewedAt,
rl.recommend_id AS recommendId, rl.content_id AS contentId, c.original_title AS bookTitle, c.author AS author, c.publisher AS publisher, c.image_url AS imageUrl, c.reading_time AS readingTimeText, rl.recommended_at AS recommendedAt, rl.correct_count AS basicCorrectCount, rl.total_count AS basicTotalCount, rl.status AS basicStatus, -- 독서 시간은 문제풀이 시작 전까지만 흐른다: 이미 제출해서 얼어붙은 값(frozen.read_minutes)이 -- 있으면 그 값을 그대로 쓰고(재도전해도 최초 제출 시점 값으로 고정), 아직 한 번도 제출 안 -- 했으면 문제풀이 화면에 들어간 순간(quiz_started_at)까지만 세고 그 이후로는 안 늘어난다. -- 둘 다 없으면(아직 순수 독서 중) 지금까지 계속 흐른다. COALESCE( frozen.read_minutes, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, rl.recommended_at, COALESCE(cs.quiz_started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) ) AS elapsedMinutes,
adv.correctCount AS advancedCorrectCount, adv.totalCount AS advancedTotalCount,
badge.badgeCount AS badgeCount, badge.latestBadgeName AS latestBadgeName,
dia.diary_key AS diaryKey, att.attitudeCodes AS attitudeCodes, -- 도움 필요는 일지 스냅샷(dia.help_needed)이 아니라 학생 상태값을 그대로 본다 — -- 한 번 켜면 다음 수업에도 계속 켜진 채로 보여야 하는 값이다(2026-07-30) st.help_needed AS helpNeeded, dia.memo AS memo FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = cs.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_clinic_reservation r ON r.student_id = cs.student_id AND r.reservation_date = cs.session_date OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 recommend_id, content_id, recommended_at, correct_count, total_count, status FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log WHERE student_id = cs.student_id ORDER BY recommend_id DESC ) rl LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = rl.content_id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correctCount FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q WHERE q.recommend_id = rl.recommend_id AND q.qlevel = '02' AND q.submitted_at = ( SELECT MAX(q2.submitted_at) FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q2 WHERE q2.recommend_id = rl.recommend_id AND q2.qlevel = '02' ) ) adv OUTER APPLY ( -- 이 책(rl.content_id)에서 딴 뱃지만 집계한다 — 학생 전체 뱃지를 세면 A책 카드에도 -- B책에서 딴 뱃지가 같이 보이는 문제가 생긴다(2026-07-29 수정) SELECT COUNT(*) AS badgeCount, (SELECT TOP 1 b.badge_name FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb2 JOIN erp_bookstore_badge b ON b.badge_id = sb2.badge_id WHERE sb2.student_id = cs.student_id AND sb2.content_id = rl.content_id ORDER BY sb2.earned_at DESC) AS latestBadgeName FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb WHERE sb.student_id = cs.student_id AND sb.content_id = rl.content_id ) badge LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_diary dia ON dia.session_id = cs.session_id OUTER APPLY ( -- 태도 체크는 erp_bookstore_attitude에 1선택 = 1행으로 저장돼 있어, 화면이 쓰던 -- 콤마 문자열 형태로 다시 묶어 내려준다 (STRING_AGG는 SQL Server 2017+ 전용이라 미사용) SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + a.attitude_code FROM erp_bookstore_attitude a WHERE a.diary_key = dia.diary_key ORDER BY a.id FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') AS attitudeCodes ) att OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 read_minutes FROM erp_bookstore_diary_detail WHERE diary_key = dia.diary_key AND content_id = rl.content_id ) frozen

APPLY ( -- 이 책(rl.content_id)에서 딴 뱃지만 집계한다 — 학생 전체 뱃지가 아니다(2026-07-29 수정) SELECT COUNT(*) AS badgeCount, (SELECT TOP 1 b.badge_name FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb2 JOIN erp_bookstore_badge b ON b.badge_id = sb2.badge_id WHERE sb2.student_id = r.student_id AND sb2.content_id = rl.content_id ORDER BY sb2.earned_at DESC) AS latestBadgeName FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb WHERE sb.student_id = r.student_id AND sb.content_id = rl.content_id ) badge LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_diary dia ON dia.session_id = cs.session_id OUTER APPLY ( -- 태도 체크는 erp_bookstore_attitude에 1선택 = 1행으로 저장돼 있어, 화면이 쓰던 -- 콤마 문자열 형태로 다시 묶어 내려준다 (STRING_AGG는 SQL Server 2017+ 전용이라 미사용) SELECT STUFF(( SELECT ',' + a.attitude_code FROM erp_bookstore_attitude a WHERE a.diary_key = dia.diary_key ORDER BY a.id FOR XML PATH('') ), 1, 1, '') AS attitudeCodes ) att OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 read_minutes FROM erp_bookstore_diary_detail WHERE diary_key = dia.diary_key AND content_id = rl.content_id ) frozen
mapper.select: SELECT attitude_code AS attitudeCode, attitude_name AS attitudeName FROM erp_bookstore_attitude_code WHERE use_yn = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT rl.content_id AS contentId, c.original_title AS bookTitle, c.author AS author, c.publisher AS publisher, c.image_url AS imageUrl, c.reading_time AS readingTimeText, rl.recommended_at AS recommendedAt, rl.correct_count AS basicCorrectCount, rl.total_count AS basicTotalCount, rl.status AS basicStatus, -- cardColumns/reservationCardColumns와 같은 규칙(독서 시간은 문제풀이 시작 전까지만 흐름) COALESCE( frozen.read_minutes, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, rl.recommended_at, COALESCE(cs.quiz_started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) ) AS elapsedMinutes, adv.correctCount AS advancedCorrectCount, adv.totalCount AS advancedTotalCount, badge.badgeCount AS badgeCount, badge.latestBadgeName AS latestBadgeName FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content c ON c.content_id = rl.content_id OUTER APPLY ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN q.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correctCount FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q WHERE q.recommend_id = rl.recommend_id AND q.qlevel = '02' AND q.submitted_at = ( SELECT MAX(q2.submitted_at) FROM erp_bookstore_quiz_answer_log q2 WHERE q2.recommend_id = rl.recommend_id AND q2.qlevel = '02' ) ) adv OUTER APPLY ( -- 이 책(rl.content_id)에서 딴 뱃지만 집계 — 카드 캐러셀에서 책마다 따로 보여줘야 한다 SELECT COUNT(*) AS badgeCount, (SELECT TOP 1 b.badge_name FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb2 JOIN erp_bookstore_badge b ON b.badge_id = sb2.badge_id WHERE sb2.student_id = rl.student_id AND sb2.content_id = rl.content_id ORDER BY sb2.earned_at DESC) AS latestBadgeName FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb WHERE sb.student_id = rl.student_id AND sb.content_id = rl.content_id ) badge OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 session_id, quiz_started_at FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session WHERE student_id = rl.student_id AND session_date = #{date} ORDER BY session_id DESC ) cs OUTER APPLY ( SELECT TOP 1 dd.read_minutes FROM erp_bookstore_diary dia JOIN erp_bookstore_diary_detail dd ON dd.diary_key = dia.diary_key AND dd.content_id = rl.content_id WHERE dia.session_id = cs.session_id ) frozen WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND (CAST(rl.recommended_at AS DATE) = #{date} OR rl.status = 'PENDING') ORDER BY rl.recommend_id ASC
mapper.update: MERGE erp_bookstore_diary AS target USING ( SELECT cs.session_id, cs.student_id, cs.session_date, cs.entered_at, cs.exited_at, (SELECT TOP 1 r.time_slot FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_reservation r WHERE r.student_id = cs.student_id AND r.reservation_date = cs.session_date ORDER BY r.reservation_id DESC) AS time_slot FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs WHERE cs.session_id = #{sessionId} ) AS source ON target.session_id = source.session_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET help_needed = #{helpNeeded}, memo = #{memo}, created_by = #{createdBy}, out_time = COALESCE(target.out_time, source.exited_at), updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (session_id, student_id, record_date, record_time, in_time, out_time, help_needed, memo, created_by) VALUES (source.session_id, source.student_id, source.session_date, source.time_slot, source.entered_at, source.exited_at, #{helpNeeded}, #{memo}, #{createdBy});
UPDATE erp_student SET help_needed = #{helpNeeded}, updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

mapper.update: MERGE erp_bookstore_diary AS target USING ( SELECT cs.session_id, cs.student_id, cs.session_date, cs.entered_at, cs.exited_at, st.help_needed, (SELECT TOP 1 r.time_slot FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_reservation r WHERE r.student_id = cs.student_id AND r.reservation_date = cs.session_date ORDER BY r.reservation_id DESC) AS time_slot FROM erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs JOIN erp_student st ON st.student_id = cs.student_id WHERE cs.session_id = #{sessionId} ) AS source ON target.session_id = source.session_id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (session_id, student_id, record_date, record_time, in_time, out_time, help_needed) VALUES (source.session_id, source.student_id, source.session_date, source.time_slot, source.entered_at, source.exited_at, source.help_needed);

UPDATE dia SET out_time = COALESCE(dia.out_time, cs.exited_at), updated_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) FROM erp_bookstore_diary dia JOIN erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs ON cs.session_id = dia.session_id WHERE dia.session_id = #{sessionId}

MERGE erp_bookstore_diary_detail AS target USING ( SELECT c.content_id, c.original_title, c.image_url, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, rl.recommended_at, COALESCE(cs.quiz_started_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS read_minutes FROM erp_bookstore_content c LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl ON rl.recommend_id = #{recommendId} LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_diary dia2 ON dia2.diary_key = #{diaryKey} LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_clinic_session cs ON cs.session_id = dia2.session_id WHERE c.content_id = #{contentId} ) AS source ON target.diary_key = #{diaryKey} AND target.content_id = source.content_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET recommend_id = #{recommendId}, basic_correct_cnt = CASE WHEN #{qlevel} = '01' THEN #{correctCount} ELSE target.basic_correct_cnt END, basic_total_cnt = CASE WHEN #{qlevel} = '01' THEN #{totalCount} ELSE target.basic_total_cnt END, advanced_correct_cnt = CASE WHEN #{qlevel} = '02' THEN #{correctCount} ELSE target.advanced_correct_cnt END, advanced_total_cnt = CASE WHEN #{qlevel} = '02' THEN #{totalCount} ELSE target.advanced_total_cnt END WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (diary_key, content_id, recommend_id, book_name, book_img, read_minutes, basic_correct_cnt, basic_total_cnt, advanced_correct_cnt, advanced_total_cnt) VALUES (#{diaryKey}, source.content_id, #{recommendId}, source.original_title, source.image_url, source.read_minutes, CASE WHEN #{qlevel} = '01' THEN #{correctCount} END, CASE WHEN #{qlevel} = '01' THEN #{totalCount} END, CASE WHEN #{qlevel} = '02' THEN #{correctCount} END, CASE WHEN #{qlevel} = '02' THEN #{totalCount} END);
